handoff.summary: Cycle 1 of the feat/abstract-model rewrite: projected the new ESSENCE (abstract-model pillar 1) into 22 Specs (S-001..S-022) and 17 Todos (T-001..T-017), then completed the first batch. T-001 established src/domain as the pure DDD domain layer (purity enforced by tests/domain/purity.test.ts); T-002 implemented the reference types (View/Vote/Block, index sentinels, anchor block at slot 0) and the immutable BlockTree. typecheck/test/build all exit 0 (13 files, 100 tests). M1 code (src/core, src/protocol, src/ui) is intentionally left in place until the phase2 UI replaces it, to keep the build gate green.
next_actions: Run batch T-003 (protocol skeleton: proposer/attester, GHOST fork choice, source/target checkpoint justification/finality in src/domain) — design so T-005's per-validator message visibility slots in cleanly.
Then T-004 (determinism + rewind via recompute-from-scenario) and T-005 (local view / message delivery model).
Phase2 (T-006..T-008) replaces the M1 UI; delete src/core, src/protocol, src/ui and their tests when the new UI lands, and rewrite README.md for the new design at that point.

Semantic choices needing human eyes if they ever change: anchor block sits at slot 0 with sentinel parent/proposer -1; first proposal happens at slot 1 on the first slot advance; Vote.source/target are block indices of epoch-boundary checkpoints.
